sourcePolicy: Retain AA balance and explicit custom Super/Gaben clauses. Use Wiki for mechanism candidates and pinned Valve 2023-02-10 fields for historical cross-checks. Conflicts without a dated transition remain unresolved; a passing result test does not prove whole-skill equivalence.

validation.meaning: Real createBattle/applyDamage/stepBattle results. A separate explicitly labelled test documents the present Gaben aura startup boundary without claiming that boundary is original-game verified.

sources.observation: Shield strongly dispels, absorbs mitigated damage and bursts for full capacity on removal/replacement. The burst excludes unseen invisible units while allowing Shadow Realm.
sources.paraphrase: Capacity and burst are separate from actual remaining barrier health; the area target filter differs from a normal unrestricted AoE.
sources.versionContext: Current 7.41d article; current numerical balance and modern Shard reflection are not imported.

sources.observation: The 2013-07-10 test update fixed recast explosions and shield damage affecting invisible/fogged enemies. 6.84 allowed disabled Borrowed Time activation; 6.85 changed its old Scepter redirect percentage.
sources.paraphrase: The recast and visibility rules predate the pinned 2023 candidate; old redirect upgrades should not be replaced by the current Mist Coil upgrade.
sources.versionContext: Dated historical changes, with current abilities kept distinct from retired upgrades.

sources.observation: Pinned Aphotic Shield KV identifies ally targeting, magical burst and a dispellable barrier; its native numbers are candidate context rather than AA balance authority.
sources.paraphrase: Use the pinned shipped ability as the historical mechanical comparison, not a replacement for AA duration/capacity.
sources.versionContext: Valve commit 6abdd9d, 2023-02-10; matching AA patch is unproven.

sources.observation: The preserved AA migration baseline specifies capacity 60/90/150, duration 15, radius 575, Super additional self shield and Gaben +400 capacity.

requirements.rule: Strong dispel removes a strong-dispellable stun; barrier capacity is consumed after resistance, with overflow applied to health and full-capacity magical burst.

testEvidence.test: strong-dispels the ally and consumes capacity after mitigation, then bursts for full capacity

requirements.rule: Expiration and replacement each produce one burst even if the old shield had unused capacity.

testEvidence.test: replacing or expiring an incompletely consumed shield still bursts once for full capacity

requirements.rule: Unrevealed invisibility prevents burst targeting; revealed invisibility and Shadow Realm remain eligible.

testEvidence.test: burst skips unrevealed invisibility but can hit revealed invisibility and Shadow Realm

requirements.rule: Ally and caster receive independent shields; the compiled Gaben +400 is applied exactly once to each.

testEvidence.test: Super gives the ally and caster one independent shield; Gaben adds its configured capacity once
